entries.title: I Chronicles 3:1
segments: And these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron. The first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel. The second, Daniel, of Abigail of Carmel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:2
segments: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur. The fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:3
segments: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital. The sixth was Ithream by Eglah his wife.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:4
segments: [These] six were born to him in Hebron. And there he reigned seven years and six months. And he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:5
segments: And these were born to him in Jerusalem Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four of Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:6
segments: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:7
segments: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:8
segments: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:9
segments: [These were] all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:10
segments: And Solomon's son [was] Rehoboam, and Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:11
segments: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:12
segments: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:13
segments: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:14
segments: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:15
segments: And the sons of Josiah: Johanan the first-born, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:16
segments: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:17
segments: And the sons of Jeconiah: Assir, and Shealtiel his son,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:18
segments: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:19
segments: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:20
segments: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:21
segments: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jesaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:22
segments: And the son of Shechaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:23
segments: And the sons of Neariah [were] Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 3:24
segments: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
